## generic_draw_markers_gen1

**Reproduced structural-validation gap; no fix applied.** Source SHA-256 `6bef5378cca3e2e50b50b86470e11629c12ad077dd78c88c1d3682e54ac719d6` has no `self_check_task`. Calls with `n_train=0`, `n_test=0`, or negative counts return empty splits instead of rejecting an invalid lesson; exact cases are retained in `checks/audit/generic_draw_markers_gen1/probe.json`.

The normal path was otherwise clean in the probes I ran: 300 tasks/1,200 pairs across easy, medium, and hard were deterministic, had exact 3-train/1-test counts, contained markers, and introduced the new output color correctly. Racket parity was 100/100 (`checks/audit/generic-draw-markers-parity.log`). The finding is therefore not a claimed label mismatch; it is the absence of a guard against structurally empty or corrupted tasks.
